plans.idea: Faithful strip version of the original: bottle at left, then a wide text column with headline and subheadline on top and the badges plus legal in one row beneath (as in the source), and a CTA at a moderate size, set in from the right edge.

Classic left-to-right banner read: product, then a tall text block with legal tucked underneath, then the badges as a proof cluster just before the CTA, so the eye moves product → message → proof → action.
Headline leads: the message opens the strip at the far left, the bottle sits in the middle as the visual anchor, and a right-hand action zone stacks the badges over the legal next to the CTA.
